study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting Heterogeneity in Functional Network Connectivity Aberrations in Antipsychotic Medication-Naïve First Episode Psychosis Patients - A Normative Modeling Study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: UAB dataset (Single Site) and Pre-trained Normative Model (approx 22,000 subjects)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We used data collected in a case-control study conducted at the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB)." ... "The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals..."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Thukral2024.pdf.md: Methods / Design, Setting, and Participants; Methods / Normative Modeling

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: UAB dataset used for clinical group analysis and calibration of normative curves. Pre-trained model used as the normative reference.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration of the normative reference curves..." "We recruited antipsychotic medication-naïve first-episode psychosis patients..."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Training used ~22,000. Calibration (part of model application/adjustment) used 122 UAB controls. Overall includes both.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals... Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration..." Table 1: HC (N = 122)

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Pre-trained model age range 2-100. Specific stats for the 22,000 sample not reported. UAB HC stats (Mean 23.59, SD 5.10) are known but represent a small fraction.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution for the ~22,000 training set is not reported.
